revise_description: Due to service quality rules, each customer must be assigned a visit day (1 or 2) and the salesman runs one route per day starting/ending at location 1. Introduce binary day assignment y[i,d], build separate TSP tours per day, enforce each customer served exactly once across days, and add daily max route length max_route_length_day plus per-day fixed route_cost_day in objective.
